name: John George Trump
summary: American electrical engineer, MIT professor, and pioneer in high-voltage particle accelerator research. Called upon by FBI in January 1943 to analyze Nikola Tesla's papers and belongings after Tesla's death. Determined Tesla's 'death ray' papers contained no workable technology. Paternal uncle of President Donald Trump.

achievements: Pioneered particle accelerator use in cancer treatment

tesla_papers_analysis.context: FBI requested analysis 2 days after Tesla's death in NYC hotel
tesla_papers_analysis.purpose: Assess if Tesla's belongings, including alleged 'death ray' plans, posed security risk

findings.general_assessment: Tesla's efforts were 'primarily of a speculative, philosophical and promotional character'
findings.technical_assessment: Papers do not include new sound, workable principles or methods
findings.death_ray_analysis: Plans do not contain enough information to actually build a weapon; any workable configuration would be of very limited power
findings.security_determination: Papers do not contain information that would 'constitute a hazard in unfriendly hands'

tesla_papers_analysis.subsequent_validation: 1984 discovery of technical papers in Yugoslavia's Nikola Tesla Museum did not overturn Trump's assessment

government_connections.fbi_consultation: Called upon for expertise in direct-current electrical equipment

family_connection.relationship: Paternal uncle of Donald Trump (45th US President)

document_releases.2016: FBI declassified ~250 pages of Tesla-related documents under FOIA
document_releases.outstanding: Some Tesla files remain missing or classified

research_questions: Were all Tesla papers actually reviewed or just a subset?
What happened to files that remain 'missing'?
What was full scope of NDRC involvement?

research_quality: HIGH - Well-documented historical figure with declassified government records
